description: Implementation of the TransactionHandler class managing transaction queues, filtering, and synchronization within the Android SurfaceFlinger frontend.

classes.name: TransactionHandler
classes.description: Handles transaction queue management, filtering, and synchronization for surfaceflinger frontend.

methods.name: queueTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction to the lockless queue and updates pending count.

methods.name: flushTransactions
methods.description: Processes and returns ready transactions, resolving dependencies and barriers.

methods.name: applyUnsignaledBufferTransaction
methods.description: Applies an unsignaled buffer transaction if conditions are met.

methods.name: popTransactionFromPending
methods.description: Moves a transaction from pending queue to the ready list, updating buffer states.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Applies registered filters to determine transaction readiness.

methods.name: flushPendingTransactionQueues
methods.description: Iterates over pending queues, applying transactions based on filter results.

methods.name: addTransactionReadyFilter
methods.description: Registers a new filter to determine transaction readiness.

methods.name: hasPendingTransactions
methods.description: Checks if there are any pending transactions or queues.

methods.name: onTransactionQueueStalled
methods.description: Marks a transaction as stalled and notifies via listener.

methods.name: removeFromStalledTransactions
methods.description: Removes a transaction ID from the stalled list.
